scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev:shared" "npm run dev:server:app" "npm run dev:web:app"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:web:app
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:server:app
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mcm/shared && npm run build -w @mcm/server && npm run build -w @mcm/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mcm/shared && npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @mcm/server && npm run typecheck -w @mcm/web
scripts.test:server: npm run build:shared && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/test.db RUST_LOG=info prisma migrate deploy && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/test.db prisma db seed && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/test.db npm run test -w @mcm/server
